plumbing.name: Alaska state plumbing (2018 UPC, state amended)

elsewhere: Alaska has no mandatory statewide residential building code outside the AHFC/state-funded cases; the borough or city decides (Mat-Su Borough, Fairbanks, Juneau each adopt their own). Check locally.
notes: DOE lists AK residential energy as Home Rule / voluntary. AHFC applies 2018 IECC (BEES) to AHFC-financed homes. Anchorage adopted the 2024 I-codes (IRC, IECC, UPC) and 2023 NEC by AO 2026-33 on 2026-04-14 (AMC 23.05.010).
